title: af.perf-report/3
description: One run's offline report (ADR-0172): its recomputed verdict, whether and why not it satisfies the required check, exact identity and provenance, every planned slot as a raw point, shard health and seeds, verified evidence downloads, the validated diagnostic child runs linked to it with each case's profile, trace and telemetry items or omissions (ADR-0177, ADR-0199), and reproduction commands that keep the frozen configuration and state their limitations.

decimal.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal, at most 38 significant digits.

rational.description: Exact signed rational in lowest terms, such as -3/4 or 2.
